question: Should this umbrella remain open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101012 handles the remaining gateway-client/protocol slice?
rationale: The issue is maintainer-authored, assigned, protected by the maintainer label, and already has one open implementation PR for the remaining work, so automation should not close or split it without maintainer sequencing intent.

options.title: Keep Open For Gateway Slice
options.body: Keep this issue as the Wave 1 umbrella while maintainers review and land or reject the open gateway-client/protocol PR.

options.title: Narrow To Gateway Only
options.body: Update the issue body or title after the two merged slices so it explicitly tracks only the remaining gateway-client/protocol consolidation.

options.title: Descope Remaining Work
options.body: If maintainers no longer want the gateway slice, close the open PR and then close this issue with that decision recorded.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Gateway Slice
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the Wave 1 umbrella while maintainers review and land or reject the open gateway-client/protocol PR.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the umbrella and all three implementation slices, including the open gateway PR.
